text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I got me a fan letter! She said<n>watchin' my races
and concerts<n>made her real happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This is some fantastic news! I'm<n>tickled pink to
have somebody rootin'<n>for me!

I know just what to do! I'm gonna<n>mosey on over
to this fan and give<n>'em a big ol' hug!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! You wanna join me, Trainer?
I desperately stop Taiki Shuttle before<n>she leaves.
